preprocess: RGB, divide by 255, letterbox to 640x640 with pad 114, planar NCHW (all R, then all G, then all B)
outputLayout: channels first: value for channel c of candidate i is at index c*8400+i; channels 0-3 = center x, center y, width, height; 4-6 = class scores
boxCoordinates: normalized 0-1 relative to the 640x640 letterboxed input; scores are already probabilities (no sigmoid)
